## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck`, and `npm test` pass locally.
- [ ] New or changed rules have tests for a case that fires and a case that does not.
- [ ] The README rule reference and `CHANGELOG.md` are updated if behavior changed.
- [ ] The PR title follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/).
